text: I'm so sorry to hear that - it's really frustrating that it's taking so long. This sort of timeline isn't normal, but it's also not entirely unheard of (I know of at least one couple that had to wait six months before their B1 was finally granted). Sometimes it is because they are making a decision and it just takes time to process, and sometimes it is because they are incompetent and lose things or forget about files. It is good that you are going in.
